headword: {栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}

definitions.explanation: A condition caused by insufficient, excessive, or imbalanced intake of nutrients, though most commonly referring to undernutrition.

examples.japanese: {栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{偏|かたよ}った→偏る：07872_katayoru⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: An unbalanced diet can cause malnutrition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんでいた→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: In postwar Japan, many children suffered from malnutrition.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧ (nutrition) + {失調|しっちょう} (imbalance, disorder). Refers primarily to undernutrition — not getting enough essential nutrients — though technically it covers any nutritional imbalance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become malnourished
- {栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into malnutrition
- {栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse from malnutrition
- {栄養失調|えいようしっちょう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of malnutrition

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧: nutrition, nourishment
- ⟦{栄養不足|えいようぶそく}→栄養不足：08627_eiyoubusoku⟧: nutritional deficiency — similar meaning, slightly more colloquial
- {失調|しっちょう}: disorder, imbalance — also appears in ⟦{自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}→自律神経失調症：30655_jiritsushinkeishicchoushou⟧ (autonomic nervous disorder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飢餓|きが}→飢餓：18841_kiga⟧: starvation, famine — a more extreme state of not having enough food at all
- {栄養過多|えいようかた}: overnutrition — the opposite problem, excess nutrient intake
